name: Katsuragi Nao
source:
A young female teacher. She has no passion for teaching, and does not like to get mixed up when her class is in trouble, so she turns a blind eye to bullying. Even though she is not involved, her action indirectly causes more bullying. She wants to get married and quit teaching to become a full-time housewife, but she has no partner at the moment.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1274293]Getchu[/url]]
